content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Physiotherapy from a recognized statutory university with at least 2 years experience. Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience working as a physiotherapist with sports organizations or national athletes. Other conditions: Character certificate from a related person is required. Must be present during practices and matches and provide treatment if injuries occur during practice.

content_sections.heading: TMC Physiotherapist Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Physiotherapist will be required to perform the following duties and adhere to operational conditions: Be present during all scheduled practice sessions and matches to provide treatment for any injuries sustained by players during practice. Verify any complaints made against the physiotherapist by players and conduct an inquiry before any cancellation of the contract.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is on a temporary contract basis for a period of 11 months. No claim for permanent absorption will be entertained. Agreement can be cancelled upon receiving complaints from players after verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of personal information, experience and other certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit the application in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of personal information, experience, and other certificates. Submit the application in person or by post to the office of the Sports Officer, Dadoji Konddev Sports Complex, Jawahar Bagh Fire Brigade Road, Thane (W). Superscribe the envelope clearly with 'Application for appointment to the post of Physiotherapist for Thane Municipal Corporation Men's Cricket Team'. Make sure it reaches by 29 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The final decision of the Municipal Commissioner will be final and binding in all matters.
